Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1092
Claimant:
Paige Wiggins
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2-28-24
First notice of loss received from the claimant describing a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection. The
claimant reports neck pain and stiffness that began shortly after the impact and asked that the claim be opened for
bodily injury and vehicle damage.
3-24-24
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active on the reported date of loss. No issues
with the policy status were found at this stage.
3-26-24
Reviewed photographs submitted by the claimant showing the rear bumper and tail lamp area of the vehicle. The
images confirm some of the damage described, though no independent witnesses have come forward to describe the
collision.
5-2-24
Spoke with the claimant about the sequence of events. The account was consistent with the first notice and the
claimant repeated the same description of the impact. The claimant could not confirm exactly where in the vehicle
they were seated at the moment of impact, so this point remains open.
6-4-24
Requested prior vehicle and medical records. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on file, and no prior injury to the
neck or upper back has been identified so far. The reported injury is consistent in type and force with a collision of this
kind.
6-7-24
Reviewed the initial medical report. Treatment began with a few visits, but additional services have been added in
each month since, and the frequency and scope now exceed what is typical for this kind of injury. The damage
estimate has not yet been reconciled with the impact, and it is not yet clear whether all of the damage resulted from
this collision.
6-19-24
Sent a request to the treating provider for itemized treatment notes and the clinical reasoning behind the added
services. A follow-up call with the claimant confirmed the same account of the collision and of the symptoms, with no
new facts introduced.
6-28-24
File remains open pending the provider response and an independent review of the vehicle damage. Nothing so far
suggests the damage predates the policy start date, but the scope of the medical treatment and the extent of the
vehicle damage still need to be resolved before a settleemnt position is set.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
